mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 1.5% signals imminent monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS falls below 1.5% during the sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0% during the sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts below 1550 and industrial production below 102 signals weakening economic demand, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances where both HOUST < 1550 and INDPRO < 102 occur simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 520,000 million dollars during late-cycle expansion signals sustained consumer spending, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in >60% of instances where RSAFS exceeds 520,000 during late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 signals contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in >60% of instances where INDPRO falls below 100 during the sample period.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 260.0 index points signals persistent price pressures, triggering premature monetary tightening and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.0 during the sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in payrolls below 152,000 thousand and unemployment rate rise above 3.7% signals labor market fragility, increasing recession probability and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >60% of instances where both PAYEMS < 152,000 and UNRATE > 3.7 occur simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 1.5% during monetary tightening cycles signals reduced liquidity, increasing cost of capital and producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% during tightening cycles.
